title: Columns.
officialText: Wood columns shall be sawn or glued laminated and shall not be less than 8 inches (203 mm) nominal in any dimension where supporting floor loads and not less than 6 inches (152 mm) nominal in width and not less than 8 inches (203 mm) nominal in depth where supporting roof and ceiling loads only. Columns shall be continuous or superimposed and connected in an approved manner.
